Its low RMSE (0.11318) further confirms its accuracy in predicting hydrogen production.  The report also compares the performance of other models like SVM, DT, RF, and XGBoost, highlighting the superiority of KNN in this specific context. The top correlated features with HPR are listed for further insights into the factors influencing hydrogen production. This analysis provides valuable information for optimizing fermentation processes and maximizing hydrogen yield.
